S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.

subtypes.Depressed Mood: A persistently sunken mood or feeling of depression.
subtypes.Tearfulness: A state of frequent crying or inability to hold back tears.
subtypes.Sadness: A state where a sad or gloomy mood is maintained continuously.
subtypes.Emptiness: A feeling of inner emptiness or a state of feeling no emotion.
subtypes.Emotional Numbness: A state where emotions feel dulled or paralyzed.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.

subtypes.Chronic Fatigue: Fatigue that persists for a long period even after adequate rest.
subtypes.Physical Fatigue: A state of physical exhaustion where the body feels heavy and easily tires even from minor activities.
subtypes.Mental Fatigue: A state where fatigue accumulates rapidly during the process of thinking or concentrating.
subtypes.Loss of Energy: Difficulty performing daily activities due to a decline in energy and vitality.

S031.name: Diminished_Thinking
S031.description: Diminished ability to think or concentrate, or indecisiveness.

subtypes.Reduced Concentration: Unable to pay attention or maintain focus on specific activities like conversation, reading, or watching TV.
subtypes.Indecisiveness: Extreme difficulty making even minor daily choices (e.g., menu, clothes) and hesitating to make decisions.
subtypes.Subjective Memory Complaints: Complaining of memory decline, such as forgetting where things were placed, due to reduced focus.
subtypes.Clouded Thinking: Thinking feels foggy, dazed, or not clear.

S083.name: Hopelessness
S083.description: A feeling of despair or having no hope for the future.

subtypes.Future Hopelessness: The persistent conviction that the future holds no possibility of improvement.
subtypes.Belief in Impossibility of Improvement: The belief that the current situation will absolutely not get better.
subtypes.Helpless Resignation: A state of helplessness and resignation, believing that nothing will change despite effort.
subtypes.Chronic Pessimism: A persistent tendency to view everything negatively and fail to consider positive possibilities.

symptom.disease_info: Persistent Depressive Disorder is a chronic depressive condition defined by a persistently depressed mood lasting at least two years, accompanied by symptoms such as low energy, impaired concentration or decision-making, and hopelessness. It often has a slow, enduring course with functional impairment that may be less dramatic than a major depressive episode but becomes clinically significant because it persists and erodes daily functioning over time.

patient.stressor_event: Major changes in working hours or conditions
patient.stressor: John’s rural clinic lost two staff members during a regional hiring shortage, and his schedule shifted from predictable medical-assistant duties to rotating early openings, late closings, and extra EMR cleanup after hours. What began as frustration with an unfair workload gradually became a 2-year-and-2-month pattern in which his mood stayed low, his energy did not recover on days off, and his usual practical confidence about school, work, and money gave way to a sense that the future was closing in. The condition became clinically significant when his concentration problems affected patient-intake accuracy and he stopped following through on basketball and electronics projects that had kept him connected and goal-directed. After a serious performance review, he used the clinic’s employee assistance referral to schedule a psychiatric assessment.

S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.
S024.manifestation: I came in because for a long time now I wake up already feeling low, like there’s this heavy gray feeling on me before I even get to the clinic, and it pretty much follows me through the whole day.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.
S029.manifestation: Even after a day off or sleeping late, my body still feels worn out, and by the time I finish rooming patients and catching up on charts, it feels like I have nothing left to do laundry, shoot hoops, or even mess with my electronics stuff.

S031.name: Diminished_Thinking
S031.description: Diminished ability to think or concentrate, or indecisiveness.
S031.manifestation: At work I’ll be staring at a patient’s intake screen and have to reread the same line over and over, and I’ve caught myself missing little details like medication doses or mixing up what I was about to ask next.

S083.name: Hopelessness
S083.description: A feeling of despair or having no hope for the future.
S083.manifestation: I keep thinking this is just how life is going to be now, working random hours, falling behind, and never getting enough money or energy to move forward with school or anything better.

add_requirements.functional_impairment: My supervisor put me on a performance plan after I made too many intake mistakes, and I’ve stopped showing up for basketball or finishing small electronics projects with friends because I can’t keep up with anything outside work anymore.
add_requirements.duration: This has been going on for about two years and two months, ever since the clinic staffing changed and my schedule started rotating all over the place.
